Josh (AE): Quick heads-up — ACME asked if we can apply a single commit / discount across multiple internal SKUs (they have separate SKUs for embeddings, reranker, and gen). Our current sheet treats them as distinct. Is there a recommended approach? Need an answer by EOD.

Priya (Pricing): Short answer: yes, via SKU normalization. We drafted a behavior for rate-sheet v3 — normalize alias SKUs to a canonical SKU and apply commits/discounts at that canonical level.

Josh (AE): Nice. Is that live? Will AEs be able to see which canonical SKU a given quote maps to?

Priya (Pricing): Not live yet — staged. Visibility plan: sales UI will show "Effective SKU" and the alias mapping on quote preview. For now, manual mapping is fine. Example mapping payload we intend to support in the rate-sheet JSON: 
```json
{
  "aliases": {
    "acme-emb-small": "emb-small",
    "acme-emb-large": "emb-large",
    "acme-gen-prod": "gen-standard",
    "acme-re-rank": "rerank-basic"
  }
}
```
This lets the pricing engine compute commit buckets against the canonical SKU.

Tomás (Deal Desk): Important: for customers who already have active commits on the old SKUs, recommend a 90-day grandfather window where we map legacy commits to the canonical SKU automatically if they signed a PO before cutover. After 90 days, new quoting must reference canonical SKUs.

Aisha (Sales Ops): How will billing show on invoices? We need line-item clarity to avoid AR disputes.

Priya (Pricing): Billing will still show the customer-facing alias SKU for clarity, but the ledger will tag the canonical SKU id for quota/commit math. So both are present.

Josh (AE): Sounds sensible. ACME asked about percent-off workflows: can we apply a percent discount on the canonical SKU that cascades to aliases?

Priya (Pricing): Yes. Discounts and commit tiers apply at canonical level; the invoice line shows alias price = canonical price * discount. Edge cases: per-SKU list-price differences — we normalize price curves where possible, otherwise a mapping table (canonical -> alias multiplier) is needed.

Tomás (Deal Desk): Action items from deal-desk: 1) approve grandfather policy (90 days) 2) require PO cutoff date for grandfathering 3) add a flag on quotes for "normalized-pricing-applied". Can pricing draft that flag name?

Priya (Pricing): Flag name: `normalized_pricing_applied`. We'll include it in the quote payload and in the rate-sheet schema doc.

deploy-bot: rate-sheet-service: rolling deploy of v3-staging (sku-normalization) succeeded in staging — https://ci.internal.redwood/integrations/rs-v3-staging/4589 :rocket:

Aisha (Sales Ops): Great — can we get a short KB for AEs with 3 examples (standard, edge with multiplier, and grandfathered commit)? I'll circulate it.

Priya (Pricing): I'll draft the KB and drop it in #sales-docs by tomorrow morning. Will also attach sample quote payloads.

Josh (AE): Perfect. I'll tell ACME we have a path and that we'll honor existing commits if they sign PO by next Tuesday. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
